operatorProperties.code:
def process(ejPopulations, waterTesting2023) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    # --- Prepare EJ municipality % (use population share in EJ block groups) ---
    ej = ejPopulations.copy()
    # Normalize municipality name for join
    ej['MunicipalityNorm'] = (
        ej['Municipality']
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
    )
    # Ensure numeric percent
    ejPctCol = 'Percent of population in EJ BGs'
    ej[ejPctCol] = pd.to_numeric(ej[ejPctCol], errors='coerce')

    # Two groups per prompt
    ejHigh = ej.loc[ej[ejPctCol] > 50, ['MunicipalityNorm']].assign(ejGroup='gt50')
    ejLow = ej.loc[ej[ejPctCol] < 25, ['MunicipalityNorm']].assign(ejGroup='lt25')
    ejGroups = pd.concat([ejHigh, ejLow], ignore_index=True)

    # --- Prepare marine samples and exceedance indicator ---
    wt = waterTesting2023.copy()
    wt = wt[wt['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('marine')]

    wt['CommunityNorm'] = wt['Community'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    # Violation is Yes/No; treat Yes as exceedance
    wt['exceed'] = wt['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('yes').astype(int)

    # --- Join and compute exceedance rates ---
    merged = wt.merge(ejGroups, left_on='CommunityNorm', right_on='MunicipalityNorm', how='inner')

    rates = (
        merged.groupby('ejGroup')
        .agg(nSamples=('exceed', 'size'), nExceed=('exceed', 'sum'))
        .assign(exceedRate=lambda d: d['nExceed'] / d['nSamples'])
        .reset_index()
    )

    # Compute difference: (gt50 rate - lt25 rate)
    rateMap = dict(zip(rates['ejGroup'], rates['exceedRate']))
    diff = rateMap.get('gt50', float('nan')) - rateMap.get('lt25', float('nan'))

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'exceedRate_gt50': rateMap.get('gt50', float('nan')),
        'exceedRate_lt25': rateMap.get('lt25', float('nan')),
        'difference': diff,
        'nSamples_gt50': int(rates.loc[rates['ejGroup'].eq('gt50'), 'nSamples'].iloc[0]) if (rates['ejGroup'] == 'gt50').any() else None,
        'nSamples_lt25': int(rates.loc[rates['ejGroup'].eq('lt25'), 'nSamples'].iloc[0]) if (rates['ejGroup'] == 'lt25').any() else None,
    }])

operators.customDisplayName: Filter water-body-testing-2023.csv to marine beach samples (Beach Type Description == 'Marine'); derive exceedance flag from Violation (Yes=1, No=0). From environmental-justice-populations.csv, compute EJ population share (Percent of population in EJ BGs) by municipality; classify municipalities into two cohorts: >50% (gt50) and <25% (lt25). Inner join marine samples to municipality cohorts on normalized Community/Municipality names; compute exceedance rate = nExceed/nSamples per cohort; output both cohort rates and the difference (gt50 - lt25) plus sample counts.
